content.text:
**Answer written to `answer.txt`:**

The **Congo Basin rainforest** (also known as the Congolian rainforests) represents approximately a quarter of the total area of remaining tropical forests on Earth. Spanning over 2 million square kilometers across six countries in Central Africa, it is the world's second-largest tropical rainforest and one of the largest and most biodiverse tracts of tropical rainforest in the world.
